## Problem

What laboratory or reproducibility problem does this solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful change. Identify affected manifests, protocol assets, provisioner code, documentation, or tests.

## Safety and scope

- [ ] The proposal is for isolated, authorized laboratory use only.
- [ ] It does not require production credentials, real OT/ICS equipment, or unauthorized network access.

## Validation plan

State the tests, generated artifacts, and—if relevant—performance evidence needed to accept the change.

## Alternatives

Describe alternatives or explain why none are appropriate.
